description: Japanese sole proprietor tax deadlines for a year: income tax return and payment for the previous year (3/15, filing from 2/16, NTA No.2020), consumption tax for individuals (3/31, No.6601), prepaid income tax (予定納税) 7/31 and 11/30 when the base amount is 150,000 JPY or more (No.2040), and the blue return application (3/15, or within 2 months of opening a business on or after 1/16, No.2070). Weekend deadlines move to the next weekday (国税通則法 第10条②). Japan, as of 2026-11-21 (e-Gov current law and NTA Tax Answer). General information and estimates only; individual tax advice and return preparation are reserved to 税理士 (税理士法 第52条).

prepaid.description: Has prepaid income tax (previous year tax 150,000 JPY+)

started.description: Business opening date (only if opened that year)

today.description: Reference date YYYY-MM-DD for days left
